clips.title: Pages
clips.line: A class is a series of pages, not one endless board.

clips.title: Editor and projector, half the screen each
clips.line: Teach in one window while the class sees the presenter window, which follows every stroke.

clips.title: A video on the board
clips.line: Open a video from the Files tab and it plays on the board, with its captions beside it.

clips.title: A YouTube link on the board
clips.line: Paste a YouTube link in the Files tab and the video plays on the board.

clips.title: Stickers, emoji and GIFs
clips.line: A bar of emoji and GIFs that come with the app: click one and it lands on the page.
